title: 260425_123108_FR_Steam_train_arriving_at_Noyelles by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Steam train arriving at Noyelles station. I made this recording during ‘’La fête de la vapeur’’ (The Steam Festival), held in La Baie de Somme (north of France), at the end of April 2026. Here, one can hear the atmosphere in Noyelles train station, while one of the steam trains exhibited and used during the festival was arriving. First, one can hear the stationmaster whistling and asking people to stay away from the railway, then the train whistling and arriving slowly, as well as the crowd’s reaction. At the end of the file, as the train has stopped, a station agent ask people to let passenge
